systems.system: National Register of Natural Persons (RNPP)/National Identity Card
systems.tiers: national foundational ID system as listed in Annex D; no digital ID credential recorded

note: A global dataset on identity ownership. For Côte d'Ivoire it gives adult ID coverage of 78 per cent (82 men, 74 women; Findex 2025, fieldwork 2024) and no digital ID: identity, not civil registration. The Annex D table's rows are misaligned in the transcription, so the RNPP row is read as Côte d'Ivoire's on the name alone; the parent should treat that entry with caution.
